rules.attack: one skill element vs each of the defender's elements; per-element multipliers multiply, so strong+weak on a dual-element pal cancels to 1x
rules.sameElement: a skill matching the defender's element is neutral (1x) — both sources state this explicitly
rules.extremeCases: 0 of our 299 pals can take 4x or 0.25x (counted from pals_1_0.json at generation time, not copied from the wikis)
